first.speaker: monk
first.text: You brought it. I felt it arrive... warm, like a lantern held to cold hands. Tell me - did you hesitate when she fell?

choices.text: She didn't seem dangerous. The whole shore loved her.

f_obey.speaker: monk
f_obey.text: Good. Hesitation is a crack, and light leaks out of cracks.

f_doubt.speaker: monk
f_doubt.text: ...Love is a mask too, child. Remember that.

second.speaker: monk
second.text: Two lights. The temple feels warmer. Do you feel it too?

choices.text: Why does the light go into your hands - and not back to our world?

s_ask.speaker: monk
s_ask.text: Because I am the vessel our world deserves. ...Do not ask again.

s2.speaker: monk
s2.text: One more. The brightest. Bring it to me, and you will finally see my face.

repeat.speaker: monk
repeat.text_low_hope: Your light dims, child. Good. It was always too heavy for you.
